audit.summary: Multiple blockers identified: (1) Primary CTA button has insufficient bottom safe margin (<20px from ad frame); (2) Yellow underline animation creates visual instability and lacks purpose; (3) Carousel dot indicators lack accessibility labels; (4) Product image in settled state is poorly cropped/scaled; (5) Animation timing and easing not optimized for user experience.

findings.issue: Primary CTA button 'Voir toutes les offres →' lacks required 20px safe inset from bottom edge of #ad-320x480. Button appears to sit within 10-15px of the frame boundary.
findings.fix_hint: Add padding-bottom: 20px to #ad-320x480 or margin-bottom: 20px to .cta-button to ensure clear space between button and ad frame edge.

findings.issue: Yellow underline (#FFF000) expands/animates unnaturally during animated state, creating visual noise and drawing attention away from product content. Animation lacks semantic purpose.
findings.fix_hint: Remove or simplify the underline animation. Use a static yellow border-bottom: 3px solid #FFF000 on the price section or CTA, or remove animation entirely and keep the underline as static design element.

findings.issue: Carousel dot indicators lack aria-label attributes and semantic meaning for accessibility. Users with screen readers cannot identify which slide is active.
findings.fix_hint: Add role='tablist' to the dots container and role='tab', aria-selected, aria-label to each dot: e.g., <button role='tab' aria-label='Slide 1 of 4' aria-selected='true' class='dot active'></button>

findings.issue: Product image in settled state (Kit dessin) appears poorly scaled or cropped. Image quality and visibility could be improved for better product showcase.
findings.fix_hint: Adjust product image CSS: ensure .product-image { max-width: 100%; height: auto; object-fit: contain; } and verify the src path resolves correctly. Consider using object-position: center to optimize cropping.

findings.issue: Carousel transition between initial and settled states lacks easing definition. Animation feels abrupt and lacks polish.
findings.fix_hint: Define transition timing on carousel elements: .carousel { transition: opacity 300ms ease-out, transform 300ms ease-out; } and use @keyframes for slide changes with ease-in-out easing over 250-400ms.

audit.regeneration_prompt:
1. Add padding-bottom: 20px to #ad-320x480 container to enforce 20px safe inset below CTA button.
2. Replace animated yellow border-bottom with static 3px solid #FFF000 border on .price-section or remove animation keyframes entirely.
3. Add role='tablist' to .carousel-dots, role='tab' aria-selected aria-label to each .dot element for screen reader support.
4. Set .product-image { max-width: 100%; height: auto; object-fit: contain; object-position: center; } to ensure proper scaling and centering.
5. Add .carousel { transition: opacity 300ms ease-out, transform 300ms ease-out; } and define @keyframes carousel-slide with ease-in-out easing for 250-400ms duration on slide changes.
